title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. subpubescens
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. subpubescens, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, skin conditions, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as antibacterial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and acting as an antiseptic agent, which contributes to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
